subject: Kickoff: romanized language ID for ingestion routing
body: Team, kickoff for improving informally romanized language identification — the follow-on to our open-source release. Why data-platforms cares: a large share of user text in South Asian languages arrives romanized, and our ingestion pipelines currently misroute it. The method work sits on three resources: the Bhasha-Abhijnaanam (B-A) benchmark, the Aksharantar romanization lexicons, and the Dakshina dataset; part of the job is just making the identifiers line up (B-A uses Assamese, Aksharantar asm, and Dakshina bn-style codes exist only for a subset). Milestones: baseline LID repro on B-A by March 20; lexicon-augmented models by end of April; integration decision for the ingestion router by early June. Alina owns staffing; Rafael is tech lead. Please put risks in the tracker, not in hallway chats. — Dmitri
